notes.title: New "The Descent" Update!
notes.content:
Hello, everybody! Today's update is for "The Descent". I felt it was a little repetitive, so I added some more variety into it. It used to be 4 levels of random gen halls/rooms with enemies scattered around (kill all enemies to advance to the next level), and then 1 big room with new weapons and big wave of enemies. But now, there are 2 more types of levels.

- Alarm level. Enemies will constantly spawn on this level. Get to the elevator at the end of the level as fast as you can before you are overwhelmed by the enemies.

- Survive level. Somewhat large room full of obstacles/cover. Survive the wave of enemies. When the wave is over, you can advance to the next level.

I also added in another "big room" at level 40. And if you reach level 40, you get the "Heavy Rifle", the most powerful weapon in the game (not including cheat code weapons). If you reach this level, you also unlock the new cheat code I added, which will allow you to have the heavy rifle in any campaign level (rather than just the final level).

Also, I fixed the co-op for "The Descent" (which broke after the recent 4 player update).

I hope you all enjoy the update, and let me know if you find any bugs!

notes.title: New update! Mouse / keyboard mode and 4 new guns.
notes.content:
Hey, everyone! Sorry this update took so long. Adding the M/KB mode and making it work alongside of the VR player took a long time.

Want to play co-op, but none of your friends have a VR headset? Too chicken to play the dark levels alone? Well, now you can have a friend/sibling/lover/hooker play co-op with you on a flat monitor with the new mouse / keyboard mode! M/KB mode will launch automatically if you don't have a VR headset connected, or you can switch to M/KB by pressing the spacebar in the lobby.

4 new guns!
- Burst fire pistol (for when the starting pistols just aren't cutting it anymore and you've stored a lot of pistol ammo).
- Low RoF SMG with a larger magazine and very low recoil (for the more deliberate among us).
- Sniper rifle. Powerful semi-auto rifle with a zoomable holo-projection sight.
- Laser Sniper rifle. Extremely powerful semi-auto laser rifle with a zoomable holo-projection sight. Uses a large amount of energy cells.

Lots of bug fixes and some optimizations. A huge thank you to anyone who has sent me bug reports! The campaign is relatively long and it takes a very long time to retest the entire campaign every time I make an update, so your help is very much appreciated.

Inhumanus is 50% off right now ($7.50). Every sale helps me out a lot and allows me to put more time into improving this game, and finishing up my other game in development.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/767970/Inhumanus/


Here is a pic of the M/KB mode + the holo-projection sight on the new sniper rifle.
https://imgur.com/mnPrP5Y

Here is a pic of the new guns.
https://imgur.com/2oGr803

Thank you for your support, and let me know if you have any issues or suggestions!

Have fun!

notes.title: New FINAL Level "Destruction"!
notes.content:
-The final level "Destruction" is now complete! The level also contains a new enemy.

-You can now have your belt guns appear by your hand when you click the selector button. You can change this on your watch under "Gun Belt Mode". 

Extra movement options have been added, including:
- Move Direction: Changes whether trackpad movement is based on the direction of your hand, or the direction your head is facing.
- Trackpad Turn: Allows the ability to turn using your dominant hand's trackpad. Has the option for either incremental or continuous turn;
- Trackpad Turn Speed: Slow, medium, or high.

We hope you all the final level and these extra options! Let us know if there are any bugs, or if you have any suggestions.

notes.title: New Level "Landing Bay" + 50% off sale!
notes.content:
Sorry this update took a lot longer than I thought it would. It's been a very crazy summer! I hit a big milestone in my life (lets just say, the Goose is no longer flying solo).

Anyway, this update brings a new level!

- Landing Bay. This level is pretty long and includes 3 new enemies (2 were already introduced in The Descent, and 1 is a brand new miniboss). This is an endgame level, so expect it to be quite challenging.

- The Decent now supports co-op. There may be a few bugs here and there, but we will test and fix anything we find ASAP.

- Added some new sounds to certain enemies and interactions (for example, when you take out a new mag and reload).

- Added some extra lore tablets.

- The cheat code room is now open at the beginning of the game (it used to open after beating the game). We did this so that you will know to start collecting the secret objects right away on your first play through.

- Fixed a bunch of multiplayer bugs.

We will be adding 2 more levels to completely finish the campaign.

A few screen shots here.

https://imgur.com/a/Tg9tE0K

Store page. Inhumanus is currently 50% off!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/767970/Inhumanus/



Also, for anyone who prefers to do their battling in a dome, I'm pleased to announce that I've begun work on Battle Dome 2! And to celebrate, the original Battle Dome is 80% off.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/484870/Battle_Dome/



Thank you for your patience and support, everybody! Let me know if there are any bugs.

notes.title: New Mode "The Descent"
notes.content:
Hello, everybody! Today we bring you a big update with our new mode "The Descent". The perfect mode for those who need a break from the campaign and crave some action.

- "The Descent". The test of a true space marine. No story, just combat. Delve lower and lower into the facility filled with beasts, robots, and mutants. Earn more powerful weapons and face more fearsome foes as you progress deeper. Each level is randomly generated and features 5 different themes with matching enemies. The descent features 15 of the game's weapons and 22 of the game's enemies.

For now, The Descent is single player only, but we will be adding coop shortly. We will also be adding a special new gun that can be unlocked if you progress far enough. Expect the next update shortly.

Other additions/changes in this update include

- 2 new enemies! The "Seeker" drone which fires homing bullets which can be shot out of the air, and the "Shredder" drone that constantly fires a large amount of slow, inaccurate bullets.

- Made the colliders on some of the guns a bit larger so reloading is easier.

- Made easy and normal mode a little bit easier.

- Made the voice of the Drone companion in campaign and the voices of other players in coop a little louder so you can hear each other better during gunfights.

We hope you all enjoy the update! Let us know what you think of The Descent, as well as the campaign. We are constantly trying to improve and fix any issues that arise.


Here are some screenshots of the new mode / the two new drones.

https://imgur.com/a/SlOmtn7

Also, remember, Inhumanus is currently 34% off on Steam! Grab it before the sale ends!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/767970/Inhumanus/

notes.title: Small update, new save system
notes.content:
- The save system is now more traditional, with 4 save files that you can switch between (rather than the old system where each difficulty level was it's own save file). This will allow players to switch between difficulties without losing their progress and having to replay previous levels. The save files now also store level progress / secret collectible progress, so each save file is now completely separate.

- Lighting fixes and improvements for a few levels (fixed issue where the entire surface of certain objects would light up all at once).

- Redid some of the beginning to Level 6 (Containment) to make it more atmospheric.

- Some bug and level fixes.

notes.title: New update! Difficulty changes + new level!
notes.content:
Hey, everyone! Today we bring you a new update. This update was supposed to come out a week ago, but we have had some major technical difficulties which have been sucking up a lot of our time. Fortunately, everything is running smoothly now and we are back to work!

There are a few more levels that we want to add to the game, and rather than making it a separate DLC, we have decided to just add them right into the base game. Today we bring you the first new level! We won't go much into the details of the new levels because we don't want to spoil any of the plot.

- New level: Space. In this level, you will be piloting a small space ship (fighter). You can find some screenshots on the steam page (linked below)

- Difficulty mode changes. Many people have been complaining that the game modes are too hard, so we decided to make some big changes.
: The old normal mode is now hard mode.
: The old easy mode is now the default normal mode.
: There is now a new easy mode that is much easier than the old one.

- Added extra checkpoints to certain levels (mostly the beginning levels). We are still testing and evaluating the later levels to find a good balance between challenge and checkpoints.

- Game options (like difficulty) are now saved and are auto loaded when the game starts

- There are now markings on each level to show which difficulty each level has been completed on.

- Each difficulty now uses it's own save file (this will prevent easy saves where players have tons of ammo from overwriting hard/hardcore playthroughs, and vice versa).

- Added some extra tablets to help give more backstory to the plot.


Also, we are working on a new single player / co-op mode that is separate from the campaign. It will be more focused on combat/action. Expect it soon!

We hope that you all enjoy! Let us know if you find any bugs.

Steam store page

https://store.steampowered.com/app/767970/Inhumanus/

notes.title: New Update! Teleport and Hardcore mode.
notes.content:
In this update, we add traditional teleport locomotion (for those who may not like trackpad or our trackpad / teleport hybrid).

We also added a new difficulty mode called Hardcore. Enemies have less health, but do MUCH more damage. You will have to be very careful not to get hit much in this mode.

Also, we are working on adding 3 new bonus levels at the end of the game. The first new level (which will be released in our next update) will have the player piloting a space ship.

Thanks for playing, everyone! Let us know if you find any issues.

notes.title: New Update! Game options and unlockable cheats
notes.content:
Hey, everybody! Today we bring you a new update.

- We heard a lot of you request a few game options that would make the game more enjoyable for you, so we added:
- Arcade reload: Reload with a button press rather than manually reloading the weapon
- Easy mode: Enemies do less damage and have less health.
- Extra lighting: Dark levels have extra lighting so they are less scary.
- Level skip: Stuck on a level that is either too scary/hard to play through? We still want you to be able to enjoy the rest of the levels (you paid for the game, you should be able to enjoy all of the content).

- We also thought it would be fun to have some cheat codes that you could unlock, so we added 5 of them.

- We hid some collectible items in each level that you have to find. Find them all to unlock a cheat code.

- We upgraded the headshot effect. Monsters heads now explode more and shoot out gibs.

- Lots of little tweaks and fixes.

For now, the new options can only be used in single player mode. But we are planning to allow certain options (easy mode, arcade reload, extra light) to be selectable for co-op games as well.


Here is a pic showing some of the new content

https://i.imgur.com/KMRlLso.png

And store page

https://store.steampowered.com/app/767970/Inhumanus/

I hope you all enjoy! Let me know what you think.

notes.title: Update! A few new features
notes.content:
Hey, everyone. There are a few new features in this update, so I thought I'd let you know.

- You can now toggle your helmet light on/off
- You can now adjust your move speed when using trackpad movement
- You can now adjust the teleport frequency when using the hybrid movement
- The number of players online now shows in the lobby
- Enemy bodies now have a cool dissolve/burn away effect after death
- Some bug fixes and tweaks

I hope you are all enjoying the game!

notes.title: First patch!
notes.content:
Hey, everybody. I just released a patch with tons of tweaks and bug fixes, so make sure you update. We will be working as hard as we can to fix any bugs and tweak/improve the game as fast as possible.

There will be many more patches, so from now on I'll save the announcements for bigger updates that feature new content.

Thanks to everyone who bought the game, and to anyone who provided bug reports and/or feedback!
